subject.title: refactor(plugin-sdk): isolate core session state from plugin mutations

question: Should getAcpSessionManager() break its released concrete-class identity immediately to close the private-session-state escape path, or must the facade use a versioned or deprecated transition?
rationale: The patch cannot both preserve observable concrete manager identity and fully remove that escape path. Repository policy requires owner intent for a shipped Plugin SDK break, and the discussion contains no maintainer approval.

options.title: Stage a facade API
options.body: Add a new facade getter, deprecate the concrete getter with a named removal window, and migrate internal callers now.

options.title: Approve the immediate break
options.body: Explicitly accept the released plugin compatibility break because closing the boundary now outweighs class-identity compatibility.

options.title: Defer to a breaking release
options.body: Pause the ACP portion until a planned Plugin SDK breaking window while retaining the session projection work separately.

recommendation.title: Stage a facade API
recommendation.body: Add a new facade getter, deprecate the concrete getter with a named removal window, and migrate internal callers now.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner to both Plugin SDK contract cleanup and plugin runtime architecture.
